summary: Iter 17 (Parent Digest Emails) — Both backend & frontend tested. 15/15 backend tests pass (1 originally skipped, then fixed). Frontend Account page renders the new 'Family digest email' section correctly with toggle, cadence (Daily/Weekly), timezone, send time, weekday row, send-sample button, and persisted next_due/last_sent footer. Send-sample to parent@demo.com returns sent=true with a Resend email_id. AI tips are generated once via Claude (first send) and cached in db.digest_weekly_tips (verified — 1 cached doc, generated_at present). Article rotation across send-samples confirmed (>=2 distinct articles recorded in seen_article_ids). Scheduler boot log present in backend.err.log. Validation normalization works (Mars/Olympus → America/Los_Angeles, hour=99 → 23). Co-parent opt-in is independent of parent. dispatch_due_digests respects enabled gating. PUT enable=true sets next_due_at at next 20:00 PT; weekly with weekday=6 returns next Sunday at the chosen hour; PUT disable clears next_due_at.

design_issues.screen: Account → Family digest email → Send time / Day of week select
issues: React dev-mode console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This is caused by the dev tooling injecting x-component spans into <option> text — production builds are unaffected. No functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: digest_service.py is ~530 lines and combines content aggregation, AI prompt building, HTML rendering, Resend dispatch, and scheduler entry — consider splitting into digest_render.py (HTML/text builders) + digest_service.py (pipeline) to keep each file focused and < 350 lines.

digest_service._build_and_send updates next_due_at on Resend failure with the same prefs object — good for backoff, but worth adding a logger.warning summarising 'will retry at <next_due_at>' for observability.

Curated articles URLs in digest_articles.py point to generic landing pages (e.g. https://chadd.org/for-parents/overview/) instead of specific posts — fine for evergreen rotation but a future refresh might find deeper article URLs to make 'Worth a read' feel more current.

compute_next_due always advances by 1 day / 1 week when target<=local_now; if a user PUTs prefs at exactly preferred_hour:00, they'll never get today's slot. Minor — likely intentional and avoids duplicate sends after edit.
test_credentials: parent@demo.com / demo1234; coparent@demo.com / demo1234 — both already present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test uses existing demo parent (Enzo linked) and demo co-parent. Resets parent digest prefs to disabled at module start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 17 digest emails work end-to-end with real Resend delivery (sender domain missionsparks.com verified). To avoid burning Resend quota in future runs, monkey-patch resend.Emails.send before calling /api/me/digest/send-sample, or temporarily unset RESEND_API_KEY. db.digest_weekly_tips caches AI tips per student for 7 days. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_digest.py and run in ~4 seconds. Scheduler boot log line: 'Digest scheduler started (hourly at :05).' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. The new Account page section uses data-testids: digest-section, digest-enable-toggle, digest-enable-state, digest-config, digest-cadence-{daily,weekly}, digest-tz, digest-hour, digest-weekday-row, digest-weekday-{0..6}, digest-send-sample, digest-last-sent, digest-next-due.
